milktea.description:
Milktea is an Android app for Mastodon and Misskey client application
Milktea was developed with the following goals in mind:

- To make the Fediverse experience as seamless as possible, minimizing the awareness of software differences.

Provide an Android-like UI

- The UI should be easy to use and intuitive for users migrating from competing services.

- Add unique features to make it easier to use.

・Ability to carry out continuous development

To enable people to live a Fediverse life without being conscious of the existence of the Fediverse.
